title: Valid Digit Number
summary: Given an integer n and a digit x, determine if n contains at least one x but does not start with x.
statement: Given an integer n and a digit x, determine if n contains at least one x but does not start with x. Return true if valid, otherwise false.
constraints: Determine whether decimal n contains digit x at least once.
The leading digit of n must not equal x.
Return true only when both conditions hold.
hints: Convert n and x to decimal strings.
Use membership to establish at least one occurrence.
Compare x with the first character to reject a leading occurrence.

tests.explanation: Zero occurs inside 101 and is not its leading digit.
Five occurs, but it is the leading digit, so return false.
